dogecoin.text:
Elon Musk again told during the conference "The Word Word" that all his key companies own bitcoin, and he personally invested also Ethereum and Dogecoin 💰.

In the future, Tesla may resume selling electric cars 🚗 bitcoins, as its production is shifting towards renewable energy.
